CAPITALISM, COMMUNISM AND ISLAM Islam Refutes Capitalistic Trend : Islam neither supports dependence on individual generosity nor the capitalistic trends to solve the problem of poverty and hunger. It does not reckon the rich to be the real owner of his wealth and at liberty to spend it to his heart’s content, whether he gives it in the way of God, or for the satisfaction of his mind and heart. Or he may be miser not to spend anything out of the wealth. And this particular notion was that of Qarin who said that he had earn- ed it by his art denying the blessings of God. He usurped the rights of his community and so God punished him by thrusting him into the earth as we read in the Holy Qur’an :
